name: Fools Garden
source:
Down the Red river following the Mountains path, at the very end of it, you'll find an abandoned greenhouse, an incredibly big and beautiful one. It belonged to a witch and her lover, a gift from and for one another. No one knows what really happened there, what came to be of the lovers or their special place, but you know, there's this strange rumor... Have you ever heard about the Garden of Eden and the Myth of the Weeping Tree, an abnormally tall lemon tree that with a strange power, the power to grant an immortal wish, rumor has it, that greenhouse its their home. Many have tried their luck with that place but few returned, and those who have seem different in many ways. 

If you decide to venture trough those parts don't wander too far from the trails or you might find yourself lost between branches and flowers and never find your way back home.

You're Lysander Neredras, somehow you ended up at a small village deep in Lightyur, where you settled in. Rumors, stories, myths, this place seems to be overflowing with them. The town people tell you to stay away, that nothing good will come out of it, but you don't care. You gather yourself and follow down the mountains path.
